about_the_game:
humanity's last hope rests in your hands. Command a fleet of powerful ships as you battle through waves of enemy vessels, each more dangerous than the last. Progress actively or passively as you conquer the galaxy and protect Earth from a galactic threat.

Buy and upgrade a fleet of advanced ships to aid you in your mission. Travel through space-time in a bubble that enhances human science, allowing you to face off against some of the most advanced civilizations in the universe. Break the laws of physics by journeying through black holes, repeating the cycle to conquer them all.

With over 200 high-quality ship models, enjoy the game in observer mode where you can zoom in on the action and witness epic battles. Activate the desktop mode to watch your fleet soar across your screen while you work or focus on other tasks.

Need guidance? Use the holographic projector to summon your assistant, who will provide valuable tips and tutorials to help you succeed.

Will you be the one to save humanity and conquer the galaxy?

short_description: Fight off a galactic threat in this idle clicker game. Battle waves of enemy ships, progress actively or passively, and save humanity. With over 200 high-quality ship models and background mode, watch your fleet soar across your desktop while you work!
